floor-0.description: The base color for the whole screen (or page). Use it in case you want the content to be placed directly on this layer.

floor-1.description: For containers placed on top of floor-0 layer. In Admin Panel: left menu, Drawers, Bottom sheets

floor-2.description: For containers placed on top of floor-1 layer or surface. In Admin Panel: Tabbars, Dialogs, Dropdowns

floor-3.description: For containers placed on top of floor-2 or surface.

danger-primary.description: For icons and other graphic elements placed together with text of color text/danger.

danger-secondary.description: For icons and other graphic elements placed NOT together with text of color text/danger.

warning-primary.description: For icons and other graphic elements placed together with text of color text/warning.

warning-secondary.description: For icons and other graphic elements placed NOT with text of color text/warning.

positive-primary.description: For icons and other graphic elements placed together with text of color text/positive. Attn! If tomorrow Bolt's brand color became pink, should your element still be green? If the answer is NO, use ACTION color instead. Is your element a link? If YES, use LINK color instead.

positive-secondary.description: For icons and other graphic elements placed NOT together with text of color text/positive. Attn! If tomorrow Bolt's brand color became pink, should your element still be green? If the answer is NO, use ACTION color instead. Is your element a link? If YES, use LINK color instead.
